command: for d in /sys/block/mmcblk*/device; do echo DEVICE=$d; for f in cid name manfid oemid serial date; do printf '%s=' $f; cat $d/$f; done; done; df -h / /boot
ip -br addr; ip route; for f in /sys/class/net/eth*/carrier /sys/class/net/eth*/operstate; do printf '%s=' $f; cat $f; done; ss -lntp; systemctl is-active ssh sshd dropbear dfx-mgr

xmutil listapps; ls -l /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/; sha256sum /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/*.bit.bin /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/*.dtbo /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/*.xclbin; lsmod | grep -E 'zocl|xlnx'; xbutil --version
